title: CDDS Types
description: The types of the CDDS type definitions (types.proto). The types are shared between the CDDS service configuration schemas.

TransmitterId.title: TransmitterId
TransmitterId.description: Denotes an transmitter like an antenna of the ground station involved in service production (reception or transmission).

globalForm.description: The OID for instance as per SANA Sites and Aperture registry: https://sanaregistry.org/r/service_sites_transmitters/. Other unique OIDs denoting terrestrial service providers or relay satellites may be used.

localForm.description: The local form is a string identifier of the transmitter agreed among service user and service provider

not.description: The transmitter id is specified either in global form or in local form.

ReceptionMetaData.title: ReceptionMetaData
ReceptionMetaData.description: Meta data of received data. Indicates which transmitter or antenna received data at a certain time and a data link continuity.

receiveTime.description: For a telemetry frame received on the data link layer, the receiveTime shall contain the UTC time at which the signal event corresponding to the leading edge of the first bit of the Attached Sync Marker that immediately preceded this encoded or un-coded frame was presented at the receiver used to receiver the frame. For frames received somehow encapsulated, the receive time shall indicate the receive time of the underlying unit encapsulating this unit.

transmitterId.description: The transmitterId shall indicate which transmitter or antenna was used to acquire the frame.

dataLinkContinuity.description: The dataLinkContinuity shall indicate whether the extracted frame is the direct successor of the previous frame on the selected Master or Virtual Channel. A value of '-1' indicates that this is the first frame after the start of production or the selected channel is a Master Channel carrying AOS Transfer Frames or USLP Transfer Frames and therefore no information regarding a discontinuity on the channel can be provided.

FrameQuality.title: FrameQuality
FrameQuality.description: An enum indicating the frame quality. INVALID_FRAME_QUALITY: not initialized; GOOD: the frame decoded successfully; ERRED: the frame is undecodable; UNDETERMINED: frame decoding was not performed; ALL: all frame qualities.

DateTime.title: DateTime
DateTime.description: Date / Time definition for epoch 1958 with pico second precision. When a lower resolution is used, the unused least significant time components shall be represented by zero-valued fields.

msOfDay.description: The milli seconds of the day

picoSecsOfMs.description: The pico seconds of the milli second

Duration.title: Duration
Duration.description: A type to represent durations in seconds, optionally with a milli second or pico seconds precision.

milliseconds.description: Optional milli seconds of the seconds

picoseconds.description: Optional pico seconds of the seconds

not.description: The fractions of the seconds are specified either in milli seconds or in pico seconds.

Annotation.title: Annotation
Annotation.description: An annotation composed out of a name and a value.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: A value composed out of a particular type. For more details see https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/proto3/#scalar

octetStringValue.description: Base64 encoded sequence of bytes no longer than 2^32

QualifiedValue.title: QualifiedValue
QualifiedValue.description: A qualified value has a value and is qualified to indicate validity and alarm states.

valueQualifier.description: The value qualifier providing the validity of the value

alarmQualifier.description: The alarm qualifier providing the alarm state of the value

EncodedQualifiedValue.title: EncodedQualifiedValue
EncodedQualifiedValue.description: A qualified value for encoded values. An encoded value (e.g. in Protobuf) must be encoded and decoded.

encodedTypeIdentifier.description: The Object Identifier identifying the type of the encoded value

encodedValue.description: The encoded value, e.g. Protobuf encoded, base64 encoded

valueQualifier.description: The value qualifier providing the validity of the value

alarmQualifier.description: The alarm qualifier providing the alarm state of the value

ValueQualifier.title: ValueQualifier
ValueQualifier.description: A value qualifier qualifies values with respect to the validity of the value. INVALID_VALUE_QUALIFIER: not initialized; VALID_VALUE: the value is valid; UNKNOWN_VALUE: the value is now known to the provider; UNDEFINED_VALUE: the value is in known to the provider, but not defined in the current context.

Alarm.title: Alarm
Alarm.description: An enum to report on alarms and warnings. INVALID_ALARM: not initialized; NO_ALARM: no alarm present; WARNING: a warning is present; ALARM: an alarm is present.

alarmReason.description: A generic optional reason code for alarms

alarmMessage.description: An optional message describing the alarm for operators

ProductionState.title: ProductionState
ProductionState.description: The state of the service production. Note: CDDS Services can refine the meaning of the service production. INVALID_PRODUCTION_STATE: not initialized; CONFIGURED: the service is configured but is not yet operational; OPERATIONAL: the service is operating and functioning; HALTED: the service has been halted by a management action; INTERRUPTED: the service has encountered a fault and is interrupted.

LockStatus.title: LockStatus
LockStatus.description: INVALID_LOCK_STATE: not initialized; IN_LOCK: in lock; OUT_OF_LOCK: out of lock; UNKNOWN_LOCK: unknown.

virtualChannelId.description: The virtual channel identifier of the frame

GvcIdList.title: GvcIdList
GvcIdList.description: A list of Global Virtual Channel Identifiers.

gvcId.description: The list of Global Virtual Channel Identifier

FrameVersion.title: FrameVersion
FrameVersion.description: The frame version corresponding to the CCSDS frame versions. TM_TC_SDLP (0): CCSDS 132.0 TM Space Data Link Protocol or CCSDS 232.0 TC Space Data Link Protocol; AOS (1): CCSDS 732.0 AOS Space Data Link Protocol; PROX1 (2): CCSDS 211.0 Proximity-1 Space Data Link Protocol; USLP (12): CCSDS 732.1 USLP Space Data Link Protocol; UNKNOWN (100): unknown frame version (non CCSDS).

oidString.description: An optional OID string in dotted notation. Example: 1.2.3.4.5

arcs.description: The sequence of numbers representing the Object Identifier. Arc is the official ITU-T X.660 term for a component of an OID.

EnumQoS.title: EnumQoS
EnumQoS.description: The Quality of Service definition governs the message delivery. INVALID_QOS: not initialized; AT_MOST_ONCE: data shall be delivered 0..1 time; AT_LEAST_ONCE: data shall be delivered at least once, but potentially more often; EXACTLY_ONCE: data shall be delivered exactly once.

NoArg.title: NoArg
NoArg.description: Used for gRPC methods without argument.
